coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Virtual desktop architecture represented by several quiet workstations connected through luminous pathways into one secure cloud-like vaulted hub, without screens or interface imagery.
Scene/backdrop: A clean slate floor under a warm paper architectural canopy.
Subject: Three miniature desks represented by chairs and blank translucent panels, cyan conduits, and a central navy vaulted hub with one orange access light.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe connected hub silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: secure, distributed, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: translucent panels must remain blank; no device screens or product UI; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
